title.zh: 扩散机理：原子迁移不是匀速直线
title.en: Diffusion mechanism: atoms do not move uniformly along straight lines

subtitle.zh: 浓度梯度 / 扩散系数 / 点缺陷 / 温度依赖
subtitle.en: Concentration gradient / diffusion coefficient / point defects / temperature dependence

body.zh: 核心判断：原子受浓度或化学势梯度驱动，迁移速度还取决于温度、元素与点缺陷。
body.en: Key judgment: concentration or chemical-potential gradients drive atoms; migration also depends on temperature, species and point defects.

body.zh: 原子如何在晶格中迁移
body.en: How atoms migrate through a crystal lattice

body.zh: 通过点缺陷在晶格中跳迁，沿浓度梯度发生再分布
body.en: Point-defect-mediated hopping redistributes atoms along concentration gradients

body.zh: 扩散使浓度曲线随时间展宽
body.en: Diffusion broadens a concentration profile over time

body.zh: 一 初始（建立表面浓度后）
较长时间（曲线更宽更深）

body.en: Broadens the profile and deepens the junction

body.zh: 掺杂原子通过空位或间隙机制在晶格中迁移
body.en: Dopant atoms migrate through vacancy or interstitial mechanisms

body.zh: 从建立表面浓度到冷却冻结的典型过程
body.en: Typical sequence from surface concentration establishment to freezing the profile by cooling

body.zh: 扩散行为由多种因素共同决定
body.en: Multiple factors jointly determine diffusion behavior

body.zh: • 不同元素扩散系数不同
body.en: • Different species have different diffusion coefficients

body.zh: • 可能占据不同晶格位置
• 影响与缺陷的相互作用
• 空位/间隙浓度影响扩散
• 气氛控制影响表面交换
提高温度会加快扩散，但也带来更多影响
body.en: Higher temperature accelerates diffusion but brings additional effects

body.zh: 扩散异常会导致器件性能偏离目标
body.en: Abnormal diffusion shifts device performance away from its target

body.zh: 多种量测手段验证实际分布
body.en: Multiple methods verify the actual distribution
SRP / junction depth and electrical behavior
Actual profile differs from the target
• Evaluate junction depth and sheet resistance

body.zh: 在以下情况下，简单的常数扩散系数模型并不总成立
body.en: A simple constant-diffusivity model is not always valid under these conditions
